The outcome was devastating. He was always gentle and brave, even when his gums ached badly. No one expected complications from routine dental work. He laid in my lap and accepted pets the morning we left for the vet. I wish there was a safer way to help you. No more throbbing tooth pain. Rest happily, my dearest friend.
